_help: The goal bar on /bot/support/. Change 'raised' when tips come in (and 'target' if the goal changes), then commit. Amounts in US dollars. Set target to 0 to hide the bar. 'per' adds 'a month' after the target; remove it for a one-off goal.
title: Keep RendConomy online
note: Hosting the bot and the site's servers, every month.
